title: Write unit tests for CapitalPool
description: Add comprehensive unit tests for the CapitalPool contract covering deposit, withdraw, revenue distribution, and inflation attack resistance.
context: The CapitalPool is an ERC-4626 vault that accepts USDC deposits, mints shares, and distributes settlement revenue to LPs. Tests should cover: deposit/withdraw round-trip, price-per-share monotonicity, revenue raises pps without minting, inflation attack cost bounds, and maxRedeem enforcement.
